description: BOSTON, MA—Following the Supreme Court's devastating ruling last month allowing the Trump administration to terminate Temporary Protected Status for Haitians and Syrians, Massachusetts Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell today called on the United States Senate to immediately pass legislation introduced by Senators Ed Markey and Lisa Blunt Rochester extending TPS for Haitian nationals through 2029.

title: Andrea Joy Campbell Urges U.S. Senate to Pass Legislation Extending Temporary Protected Status for Haitian Nationals - Andrea Joy Campbell for Attorney General
